sections.text: Stator

احتفظ بالمولد 
الجزء الثابت نظيف طوال الوقت ولن تكون هناك أعمال صيانة كبيرة

Use a vacuum 
cleaner and smooth brushes for cleaning or even better if availiable dry air, not exceeding 3 
bars of air pressure

If the CO2-fire fighting 
system has been operated the generator shall be checked and cleaning of all 
parts must be performed

sections.text: الدوار

Keep the generator 
rotor clean all the time there will be no major maintenance work

Use vacuum 
cleaner and smooth brushes for cleaning

يجب أن تكون حلقات الانزلاق 
يتم فحصها شهريًا للتأكد من مدى ارتدائها والتشغيل السليم

Worn brushes should be 
changed when wear is approximately fifty percent of the original length (use for 
rotor earth fault)

Measure the insulation 
resistance and polarization index after the unit is out of network

التحقق من تشغيل 
الوقوف ساكنا تسخين المولد

Check the operation of the 
generator brake limits switch's

Check the operation of 
dehumidifier

Check the RTD s of hot air 
and cold air

Clean the neutral point 
of generator

Check the position of the 
rotor locking bolt

Clean the over hang of 
the stator winding by vaccum cleaner and smooth brushes

Clean the generator 
over hang by use alcohol

Keep the generator section 
of the bulb always absolutely clean
